crossRefs.note: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell…
This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”
You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’
He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,
translations.bsb: The people were waiting expectantly and were all wondering in their hearts if John could be the Christ.
translations.kjv: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;
translations.asv: And as the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether haply he were the Christ;
